# scripts/ops/Start-AvdSpendRun.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Before a sandbox run: estimate its cost, check it against your caps, snapshot what exists, and open a run record (docs/sandbox-runs.md).
